ka_wikipedia_additions_2026_11_18.note: Second check with ka.wikipedia street articles (fetch subagent). Years as the page gives them.

streets.Ketevan Dedoplis Avenue: Kakheti road (on the 1735 plan), Kakheti street (1867 plan), Great Kakheti street (1895 plan), Stepane Shaumyan 1923, Ketevan the Martyr 1990, current name 2005 (the article title has no 'Tsminda')
streets.Akaki Tsereteli Avenue: Road to the German colony in the 1820s, Struggle (Brdzola) street in the 1930s, Tsereteli 1958; end years of the first two not stated
streets.Tevdore Mghvdeli Street: Andria street until 1922 (also on the 1876 plan), Sergo Ordzhonikidze after 1922 (no year), Karl Marx 1930; the current name was given to one section in 1990
streets.Nikoloz Khudadov Street: Remontnaya street (1903 list), Khudadov for a time (no years), Remontnaya again in the 1920s, Khudadov restored in the 1950s
streets.Giorgi Tsabadze Street: Mikheil lane, Mushtaidi lane (1876 plan), Ernst Thalmann 1934, Tsabadze 1990
streets.Atsquri Street: Ferma-Avlabari great prospect until the 1920s, Atsquri great prospect (1926 reference book), Atsquri street (1940 reference book)
streets.Giorgi Chitaia Street: Avchala street (1851 plan), Vasil Cherkezishvili 1910, Soviet street 1922, Karl Marx 1930, Soviet street 1938, Chitaia 1992
streets.Beri Gabriel Salosi Avenue: Slaughterhouse street, Karaia great road (1934 plan), Bogdan Khmelnitsky 1954, other section names (Soldiers, Reuter, Germans 1922, 5 December 1939, Kakutsa Cholokashvili 1991), Salosi 2014; the order of the section names is not clear, not used on the site
streets.Revaz Tabukashvili Street: Sappers street (1841 list), Boris Dzneladze in the 1930s (1934 plan), Ioane Petritsi 1990, Tabukashvili 1992
streets.Navtlughi Street: Weissenhof street (1876 and 1895 plans), Navtlughi (1903 list)
streets.Heydar Aliyev Right Bank Embankment: only 2007 (named after Aliyev); 'Right bank' as a former name is NOT stated
